description: This header file defines utility functions for file content reading, property extraction, file type checking, directory searching, and variable expansion within strings, primarily used for configuration and file management in a C++ project.

methods.name: readPropertyFromFile
methods.description: Reads a property value from a file, supporting recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: isRegularFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: searchFilesRec
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for files matching patterns, with exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Initiates recursive file search with specified depth and exclusions.

methods.name: ExpandPropertiesInString
methods.description: Replaces variables in a string with their corresponding property values from a file.
